title: Fixed-scalar representatives on the shared total functor
statement: For a coefficient category B, a scheme T and a specified class P of K-flat cochain sheaves, assemble the published fixed-scalar representative isomorphism component by component with the shared total tensor as its source. Its hom component equals the published representative component, so no localization tensorator or derived tensor data change.

source.place: Tags 06YN and 07A4; signed total tensor and localization tensorators

proof.text: Apply NatIso.ofComponents to the existing finiteScalarFixedTensorRepresentativeForCoefficients. Its naturality proves the required naturality for the shared total tensor. Unfold the component construction to identify its hom component with the published one. All conversions occur over abstract coefficients.

lean.statement:
def finiteScalarRepresentativeTensorIso
    (B : Type*) [Category.{u + 1} B] [Abelian B] [IsGrothendieckAbelian.{u + 1} B]
    [MonoidalCategory B] [MonoidalPreadditive B] [SymmetricCategory B] [MonoidalClosed B]
    [Abelian.HasFunctorialFlatResolution B] (T : Scheme.{u})
    (P : ObjectProperty (CochainComplex (Sheaf (ProEt.topology T) B) ℤ))
    (hP : ∀ Z, P Z → (HomologicalComplex.quasiIso _ (.up ℤ)).kFlat Z) :
    (P.ι.prod P.ι) ⋙ finiteScalarRepresentativeTotalTensor (Sheaf (ProEt.topology T) B) ⋙
      DerivedCategory.Q ≅
      ((P.ι ⋙ DerivedCategory.Q).prod (P.ι ⋙ DerivedCategory.Q)) ⋙
        uncurry.obj (ProEtale.derivedTensor B T)
